workstreams.name: Address plus APN and address-only autonomy
workstreams.operatorOutcome: A normal operator can submit either a complete address with APN or a valid address alone, walk away, and receive the most complete honest Deal Card LandOS can produce without developer intervention.
workstreams.requiredDataState: Two fresh disposable leads for the same publicly resolvable control property: one complete address plus APN and minimal safe seller information, one address only with no APN.

steps: Submit the address plus APN lead through New Lead and make no manual corrections
Observe subject establishment, capability scheduling, recovery, readiness, and intelligence until settled
Inspect the resulting Deal Card through normal operator navigation
Submit the address-only lead through New Lead and make no manual corrections
Confirm autonomous parcel resolution and downstream research
Hard refresh representative results and confirm persistence without unintended reruns

failureConditions: Address-only intake asks for an APN despite a viable autonomous resolution route
Developer intervention is needed after submission
County or ZIP work waits unnecessarily on parcel verification
Deal Card intelligence is stale relative to admitted evidence

requirements.text: A fresh address plus APN intake normalizes the parcel, establishes one stable canonical subject, and autonomously settles to an honest Deal Card.
A fresh address-only intake resolves the parcel autonomously when public evidence can establish it and does not request a redundant APN.
County and ZIP work begin when their own prerequisites arrive while parcel-specific work waits for and then consumes the canonical subject.
Recovered evidence retains source, run, and subject provenance and drives bounded readiness reconciliation without churning satisfied work.
Property, Market, Seller, and Deal Intelligence become current and the visible Deal Card survives refresh without unintended research reruns.

workstreams.name: APN-only and exact document-link autonomy
workstreams.operatorOutcome: A parcel identifier with jurisdiction or an exact supported property link can establish the property without a redundant street address or identifier request.
workstreams.requiredDataState: Two fresh disposable leads for a public control property: one APN plus county/state with no street address, one exact retained LandPortal parcel URL without redundant APN/address corroboration.

steps: Submit APN plus jurisdiction through New Lead without a street address
Observe autonomous property search and honest resolution or genuine ambiguity
Submit an exact supported LandPortal parcel URL through New Lead
Confirm the link establishes the same subject and retains provenance
Inspect parcel research, readiness, intelligence, and refresh persistence

failureConditions: APN-only intake requires the operator to provide an address when the parcel can be uniquely resolved
Exact LandPortal link intake requests redundant APN or address corroboration
A downstream consumer reopens identity after canonical establishment
Link-derived evidence loses provenance or admits a different parcel

requirements.text: An APN plus sufficient jurisdiction context can establish the subject without a fabricated or operator-supplied street address when uniquely resolvable.
An exact supported LandPortal parcel URL is recognized as the property pointer and does not trigger redundant identifier clarification.
Alternate-pointer evidence retains provenance and exact-subject association through authoritative admission.
Canonical subject state remains stable and every downstream parcel consumer uses it rather than reopening identity.
The alternate-pointer Deal Cards settle autonomously as far as available evidence allows and persist through refresh and managed restart.

workstreams.name: Messy intake and final autonomy matrix acceptance
workstreams.operatorOutcome: A realistic imperfect seller-style submission is combined autonomously into a stable working subject when reasonably resolvable, and the full five-case matrix communicates honest completeness, gaps, and genuine operator action on the normal Deal Card.
workstreams.requiredDataState: One fresh difficult but reasonably resolvable seller-style lead plus the four fresh matrix leads from the prior workstreams; optionally one genuinely insufficient lead if inexpensive.

steps: Submit realistic imperfect seller-style intake through New Lead
Make no manual corrections and observe bounded autonomous resolution and research
Inspect the final Deal Card and any action-needed message as an operator
Reinspect representative successful cases after hard refresh and managed restart
Confirm no new console errors or unintended expensive reruns
Produce the five-case autonomy, readiness, recovery, intelligence, and performance matrix

testRequirements: messy intake extraction and clue combination
comp usability and honest valuation pending
focused regressions, relevant integrations, typecheck, production build, governance audits, and applicable broad suite
failureConditions: A reasonably resolvable messy lead enters an interview loop or needs developer repair
A valid recovery route remains when LandOS reports blocked
Missing zoning, comps, or valuation is guessed to make the card look complete
The normal Deal Card exposes internals instead of a clear operational story
Any successful case requires refresh or restart to continue processing

requirements.text: A fresh difficult but reasonably resolvable seller-style intake combines its clues autonomously and reaches one stable working subject or asks at most one genuinely decision-changing clarification.
Across all five leads deterministic routes run first, bounded recovery runs only when justified, and no developer action is used to turn a failed case into a pass.
Every meaningful fact and artifact used by readiness or intelligence is admitted with source, run, subject scope, and honest confidence.
Readiness and all four intelligence layers remain current after evidence changes and persist through hard refresh and managed restart without rerunning settled research.

The visible Deal Card clearly communicates the established subject, property facts, market, comp/valuation status, intelligence, unresolved gaps, and only genuine operator action without exposing orchestration internals.
